notes.title: April With No Gravity - launches, contests, giveaways and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/696b3bb5f7857d7590664f4486b0746c5926c0e2.jpg[/img]

Why should you limit yourself to just one game, when you can… [b]launch three of them in one month?[/b] And this is happening in April!

We’re excited to announce that, in the upcoming month, we’ll publish THREE new games here on Steam:

https://youtu.be/qx6_cp_QGjA

[h1]Graviter - April 8th[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/07b85bce45d6956955e44a60262db69a498549e1.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255920/Graviter/

[h1]Golden Force - April 22nd[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/bf860a7dfb5b571ba34d8240cee13a10017e5b64.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425070/Golden_Force/

[h1]Tanuki Justice - April 15th[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406250/Tanuki_Justice/

Whether you are a fan of puzzle games or retro-style platformers, you will definitely find something for yourself! [b]April With No Gravity[/b] is something more than just launches! [b]Contests, devlogs, giveaways and more - just stay tuned![/b]

Be sure to wishlist [b]Graviter, Tanuki Justice and Golden Force[/b], so you won’t miss any new announcements!

[b]Cheers,
No Gravity Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Huge update is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/d22e9df60fa910eea1a96012db771d52a62102ea.jpg[/img]

We made some changes and added extra assets for you:

1. A completely new menu. 
2. 2 new avatars: Industrial and TrashPro.
3. 2 skins for Industrial and 3 for TrashPro.
4. 5 new skins for Units: Cthulhu, ER, The Great Women's, Halloween, Goth 
5. 10 new puzzles.
6. 10 new titles.
7. Steam Achievements.
8. Steam Cards.
9. Energy system for puzzles is turned off. Players don't need it anymore.


Enjoy! And let us know your feedback :)

notes.title: A week of skillin’ the rigs
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/3ba95ace82cfa9521f2df1022b51dc8eeb0ceb7b.jpg[/img]

[b]It's been a week since we launched the [i]Rig or Skill[/i] testing program or Early Access, as the Steam platform likes to call it[/b]. We would like to thank all the participants who made the wise decision to begin making preparations for the dangerous times ahead. [b]The apocalypse will not wait for humanity to get ready. We need to start training right now[/b]. That's why, knowing rogue AIs are starting to battle each other for superiority, we launched the simulation early. We urge everyone to take part in the virtual battles, as it's now more relevant and more important than ever to stay on our toes and watch attentively for the first signs of the AI rebellion.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/4f7ec5e37bc2a554159b15d3aa6c5f7693de0ebf.jpg[/img]

[b]We're also positively grateful for all the feedback you are sharing with us[/b]. We're still working very hard on [i]Rig or Skill: PC Brawl[/i]; fixing bugs and adding more exceptional training features that will help you gain the skills necessary when battling rogue AI that are trying to vanquish humankind. [b]Your opinions and observations are worth more than your weight in gold – as they may help to save thousands of people[/b].

[b]We made a few small changes lately, that you should hear about[/b]:

1.	The game automatically checks if the newer version is available. The player is informed if he needs to update the game.
2.	We eradicated some typos.
3.	The game remembers now when the player turns Mr PC off in the options.

Please excuse us, as we must go back to scouring your e-mails, updating features and optimizing the game to your heart’s content.

[b]The end is nigh[/b]. Stay safe, friends.

notes.title: Balancing the Rigs
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/595b6239d473d5b12a2ec6435f5900ac0abc18f4.jpg[/img]

[b]Thanks to your feedback, we're able to fight off the rogue AI's sabotage once again![/b] This time we fixed some minor issues which, we hope, will make our apocalypse simulation program a bit more enjoyable for you, brave people.

[b]The list of changes is as follows:[/b]

  1. The AI is much more balanced now!
  2. We fixed the issue with prizes awarded after a match being a bit unclear for the players.
  3. AI won't be able to spawn units on "stains" anymore.
  4. Disappearing FPS counter is no more.
  5. In some instances the buttons from the menu screen stayed even after entering the match. That one's fixed as well!
  6. The sound balance is more balanced than not.
  7. Mr. PC got a bit less annoying.

[b]We're looking forward for more feedback guys! Please remember, that the humanity's survival is at stake here![/b]

notes.title: Your rig is patched NOW!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/a4ef1fe1490b765d4dcb0672af2c74405ff1d02f.jpg[/img]

As you already know, some superior AI's tried to fight back with our brave players, so they won't be able to get ready for the apocalypse. [b]Thank you for all the feedback regarding the issue.[/b] It's thanks to you, that we could react as fast as we did. The first patch to [i]Rig or Skill[/i] is live now!

Here's the change log:

1. We changed how the game renders some assets in the shop. Optimization galore!
2. The game no longer tries to overpower your rig by squeezing literally hundreds of FPS. It's solid 60 now, so everything should work as smooth as butter.
3. The polish text scales a lot better.
4. Minor text changes.
5. The bugs in the tutorial mode are gone. Tutor yourself as much as you wish. You need to be prepared for the rise of rogue AI.
6. The social buttons finally allow you to get social with your friends!

[b]We hope you'll enjoy the game much more now, and we're looking forward for more feedback.[/b]
